newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas payed tribute to former spokesman Nicolaas Wegter who left the Spokesman's service to be the Commission representative to the Netherlands.

In answer to a question, spokesman Willy Helin denied that Commissioner Karel Van Miert was blocking a Spanish government BF 500 million subsidies for a Renault plant in Spain. He said Van Miert considered that if Renault was transfering a profitable plant to another and asked for a state aid to do so, it would need a deep Commission analysis before authorizing it.

In answer to a question, spokesman Peter Jorgensen said that Austria was the only member state known by the Commission to ban genetically modified organisms. He denied reports that Luxembourg had taken similar measures.

Spokesman Gerry Kiely denied that a report on abattoirs in the UK, written in March 1996, had been submitted to the Commission. He said that it could therefore not have been suppressed by the Commission.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/175: Commission refuses Italian state aid to producers of biofuels obtained from oleaginous seeds.
- IP/97/176: Commission withholds agricultural payments to Italy, Spain and Greece due to non payment of milk levies.
- IP/97/187: Equal opportunities for women and men in the European Union.
- IP/97/188: Eurobarometre: Women and men in Europe and equal opportunities - results of an opinion poll.
- IP/97/189: Chinese accession to the WTO - statement by Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan.
- IP/97/190: Commission expresses deep concern on Albania.
- IP/97/191: Thailand - the Commission regrets the government sending Burmese refugees back to Burma.
- IP/97/192: Agreement between the European Union and Canada to strengthen cooperation in customs matters.
- Speech/97/50: Speech by Commissioner Manuel Marin at a conference on "Opportunities for investment in the Mediterranean region".
- Speech/97/51: Speech by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy on 500 working days before the euro.
- Speech/97/52: Speech by Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan at the launch of the European movement "Europe 97" campaign.
- Speech/97/53: Speech by Commission President Jacques Santer on the European construction values and references.
- Eurobarometer 44.3: Women and men in Europe and equal opportunities - results of an opinion poll.
- ME97/6.3: Midday Express.
